profile_text.body:
Credo AI is a company founded in 2020 that sells an AI governance and risk management platform, according to its website. The company describes itself as having created the AI governance category and as now defining it for the agentic era. Its platform is built around a Knowledge Graph that the site says fuses global regulatory intelligence with a customer's business context, and it is intended to let enterprises discover AI systems, enforce policy, manage AI risk, and produce audit-ready evidence across agents, applications, models, and vendors. The site says the platform covers model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance, with agents treated as governed entities that are registered, risk-assessed, sanctioned, and governed.

The site lists pre-built policy packs covering the EU AI Act, the NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, and says these were written by a team that participated in ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD work. It also describes GAIA, or Govern AI Assistant, as generally available in the platform, and cites native integrations across existing systems, with a figure of 300+ integrations. Credo AI is described as built from scratch rather than as AI features added to an existing GRC tool. The site quotes customers and partners, including Mastercard and IBM, on their use of the platform.

The record held here lists one product, the Credo AI platform itself, in the AI governance and risk management platform category, with a note citing purpose-built AI governance, policy packs for the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF, a clean interface, and fast deployment. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent facts are recorded for the company.
